title: findbuch catalogue row
description: The shape of one integrable case. This refuses shape and never meaning: a row that validates here is well formed and is not verified, and nothing in this file is evidence about the mathematics. docs/decisions/0003-row-format.md fixes the fields, 0005 the validity kinds, 0008 the identifier and the statuses, and 0009 the provenance entry.

id.description: The case identifier. A slug, opaque, never reused, and never parsed for meaning by a consumer. 0008.

name.description: The display name a reader recognises. Parsed by nothing.

status.description: 0008 fixes three and there is no fourth. Absent means active.

supersedes.description: The identifier this row replaces, where it replaces one.

superseded_by.description: The identifier that replaced this row. Required when the status is superseded, which is checked outside this file.

revision.description: Bumped when the row is corrected without changing what it is about. 0008.

structure.description: The identifier of the Poisson structure this row lives on. Required with no default: the default would be e(3), and e(3) is the wrong answer for the family most likely to be transcribed carelessly. That the identifier names a structure that exists is not decidable here and is checked outside this file.

hamiltonian.description: The Hamiltonian, as an expression string over the coordinates of the named structure and the parameters this row declares. A string, never a tree and never code.

integrals.description: The additional integrals, each an expression string over the same symbols. Empty for an invariant-relation row, which claims no integral.

parameters.description: The parameter symbols with what each one means physically. A symbol not declared here is not a free variable anywhere.

conditions.description: The parameter conditions, as expressions rather than prose, so they can be reduced against rather than read.

validity.description: The kind of validity claimed. 0005 fixes three and there is no fourth and no default: the default would be general, and the general case is the one the literature claims wrongly.

constraints.description: The constraints a conditional row holds under, or the relation an invariant-relation row preserves. Required exactly when the validity kind requires them and refused when it does not, which is checked outside this file.

domain.description: Where in the phase space and the parameter space the claim is made.

aliases.description: Other published names for this case, each with the source that uses it. Without these a catalogue with correct contents is unusable by somebody holding the wrong survey. 0008.

provenance.description: Where the row came from. At least one entry, because a row with no source is not a transcription of anything. 0009.

reference.description: Precise enough to identify one edition. A reference that resolves to two printings resolves to two tables.

language.description: The language of the text that was actually read, not of a translation that exists. 0012.

location.description: The page, and the equation or theorem number where the source numbers them. A page alone sends the next reader to a page.

notation.description: Which frame, which bracket sign convention, and what the source called the parameters. A row without this carries an unrecorded conversion nobody can check.

role.description: 0009 fixes three: the paper that first stated the case, a table or book reproducing it, and a later source that changed something.

transformation.description: The change of variables the transcription required, as an expression so it can be applied and inverted mechanically.

transformation_checked.description: Whether that change of variables has been checked. False is the honest default and the coverage report counts it.

read.description: Whether this source was read directly, or the row was taken from something quoting it.

note.description: Free text for what does not fit a field. Read by people and by nothing else.
